gate: Thermo5 TX Gate 2 model and candidate evidence

tested_source.note: The run-base tree matches remote Gate 1 branch commit 813db9c9a488b033dc4686553cbe3a06856acc0b. Gate 2 scripts and their unit tests were untracked/modified working-tree inputs at run time; source hashes are listed below. Unrelated EF2 saturation-vector and coverage edits were present but are outside the model benchmark path.

checks.name: EF2 STEP/input/PAPR/backoff/state-width staged QAM256 held-out campaign
checks.result: 108 staged development records; four disjoint held-out seeds; selected held-out point RMS=0.10, STEP=5120, 20-bit state, 0-dB backoff, no clipping; 21/224256 digital errors, EVM=2.4640%, SNDR=32.1675 dB; nominal modeled BER=1.4269e-4; stress modeled BER=7.7144e-4. No product communication target is defined.

checks.name: Held-out identity versus fixed 2/4-tap non-identity DPD images
checks.result: Identity: 7/168192 errors, BER=4.1619e-5, EVM=2.4651%; fixed 2-tap image: 126/168192, EVM=3.0433%; fixed 4-tap image: 1125/168192, EVM=4.0508%. Reject these images only; they are not fitted predistorters.

checks.name: Four-plane gain/skew/fault sensitivity campaign
checks.result: 13 scenarios and 52 seed-scenario records. Baseline 21/224256 errors, EVM=2.4640%; 2–20 ps skew and 0.2–1 dB peak-to-peak gain mismatch stayed close to baseline in this finite set. Four branch-dropout fault cases were recorded separately.

checks.name: EF2 pair-look-ahead bit-true miter and scoped VC Formal
checks.result: 4096-cycle VCS miter passed; VC Formal proved 7/7 assertions and covered 4/4 covers with zero black boxes. FPGA Fmax/LUT/FF/DSP/routed comparison was not run; PAIR_LOOKAHEAD remains disabled in the product.

checks.name: Python link-model/reference unit suite
checks.command: cd dv/uvm/refmodel/python && python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
checks.result: 39 tests passed; includes zero-skew identity and branch-reconstruction equivalence checks.

limits: No BER/BLER/EVM/ACLR/output-power product threshold was supplied; status remains TARGET_UNDEFINED.
Behavioral DPA, output network, signal power, thermal noise and noise figure are illustrative and uncalibrated.
No physical RF BER, standards-compliant ACLR, calibrated EVM/output power, or FEC result is claimed.
No FPGA synthesis/routed timing/resource/power comparison was run in this Linux campaign.
Non-identity DPD coefficient images are not fitted to the PA; this result does not reject all possible non-identity DPD designs.
